notes.title: Devblog#16 Test Combat Mode
notes.notes:
In this update, I add a combat system to the game and try about getting items from monsters.

[h1]Get New Sword from Dungeon Keeper[/h1]
The Dungeon Keeper is on the left side where you were spawned in the game. You can talk to the NPC to get a new sword and use it to combat monster

[h1]Attack Monsters[/h1]
Fight Mode controls the character as follows.
- Left Click: Attack monster
- Right Shift: Block Attack from Monster 
- Press 1 Button(Equip Sword): Switch from Normal mode To Fight mode
- Press X Button: Switch from Fight mode To Normal mode

[h1]Collect DarkSoul[/h1]
- Every you kill 1 Ghost you will earn 1 DarkSoul
- DarkSoul can collect to 200 in this update
- Give 200 DarkSoul to Dungeon Keeper you will receive DarkPortal -----------> Next Update
- Use the DarkPortal to Teleport to Dungeon -----------> Next Update

notes.title: Devblog#9 The New Update & Halloween Event
notes.notes:
[h1]The New Update & Roadmap[/h1]
Hello all players. After a long time away, I came back to update this game again. In this version, I have changed the map to 'The Local Farm' map. This map you will play in the single-player mode. Later updates I plan for the players to can buy and sell items to NPC, decorate your farm, grow many fruits and vegetables, and fight with monsters. All items received will be stored on the server. There will be some items that can craft and export to the Stream Inventory. However, in this mode, you can not meet the other players until the Multiplayer mode has been updated. I expect it will take about 14 months from now. I have a friend who owns the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/749820/Villages/]Villages™[/url] (AKA simonjames247) will take over as an Engineer to develop that mode and I will change my role to Game Designer and determine the direction of this game.

[h1]In this update (Halloween Event)[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jvlxA6X.jpg[/img]
This update is just around Halloween. So I invite the players to grow pumpkins in the glasshouse. The pumpkins plant in the plant box and take 12 hours to grow before harvest. The product will receive 12 Pumpkins and 1 Shell (A new currency that will use to buy the item in this map and cosmetic things). For the first time, the pumpkin seeds will give away from the system 30 each. And the next update v.0.1.2, I will add the shop to let players purchase more pumpkin seeds and New Halloween Collection items. 

[h1]Don't worry about the old version items[/h1]
The items from the old game version(Log, Scrap Stone, Wood, Brick) are store in the server not deleted. I will plan to convert them to a new database in later updates.

notes.title: Devblog#8 Sawmill & Brick Maker
notes.notes:
[h1]Update v0.0.7[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lNWWuo5K9YtPYWp3XR/giphy.gif[/img]
In this update I add 2 new transform system in-game 
[olist]
[*] [b]Sawmill[/b] - The Log transformed into Wood
[*] [b]Brick Maker[/b] - The Scrap Stone transformed into Brick
[/olist]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BSuzJEc.jpg[/img]
[h3]1. Adding Material[/h3]
Material items in the bag will show on the input slot. Press the add button will cause the item to be added to the system and the time will start to countdown. Adding more items, it will stay in the waiting list area. And when the items that are finished work Items that are waiting will be activated automatically.

[h3]2. Collect product[/h3]
When the product completed, the item will move to the output slot. You can collect it into your in-game inventory.

[h3]3. Upgrade transform system[/h3] 
Upgrade the system level to reduce time and increasing the number of the slot for loading raw materials

notes.title: Devblog#4 New Inventory Widget & Open Gift Box
notes.notes:
In this update(v0.0.4) I add 2 main features in the game.
[b]1. New Inventory Widget[/b]
Inventory Widget has 2 tabs, Bag tab shows your resource items in-game and World Marketplace tab shows your items on Steam Inventory. You can craft, combine or export some resource item in your bag to Steam Inventory for Buy/Sell/Trade on it
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KCRafkkdOzgOUOKl0j/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]2. Open Gift Box[/b]
You can access the Open Gift Box by interacting with Daily Gift NPC in-game. The button will show at the top right. 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/WQOY52WP5vL7Za8IAD/giphy.gif[/img]
